mu_name: Lagle, the ghost the Summoner's Book of Lagle lets loose for Pollution
mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:4544-4545: `AccessModel(MODEL_SUMMONER_SUMMON_LAGUL, L"Data\\Skill\\", L"summon_lagul")` and `OpenTexture(MODEL_SUMMONER_SUMMON_LAGUL, L"Skill\\")`, so Data/Skill/summon_lagul.bmd on lagulbody, lagulpinna and watermarkhik01 out of Data/Skill. MuMain (Season 6).
mesh_from: muextract export-obj --action=0 --key=N on Data/Skill/summon_lagul.bmd, from MuMain: 86 bones, one action of 13 keys whose last is its first, three meshes of 1255 triangles in all, about 130 by 130 by 140 units.
poses_from: Keys 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10, blended between in order and back to 0: MU plays its one action at `o->Velocity = 0.5f` a key a frame (ZzzEffect.cpp:812), so the twelve keys of the loop take 24 frames and each pose stands for two. Ours: every other key, blended, where MU blends every key.

parts.note: Data/Skill/lagulbody.OZJ, 256 square, violet. Drawn whole and faded by the joint's own fade (Move_MODEL_SUMMONER_SUMMON_LAGUL: Alpha (160 - LifeTime) / 20 as it comes, LifeTime / 40 over the last 30).
Data/Skill/watermarkhik01.OZJ, 256 square, a blue caustic. Ours: added, as a sheet painted on black reads; MU's RenderObject does not say.

frames_from: The joint's `o->LifeTime = 160` (ZzzEffectJoint.cpp:899); the Lagul follows it and goes with it.
flight_note: *How it flies* (MoveJoint, BITMAP_JOINT_SPIRIT subtype 24, ZzzEffectJoint.cpp:4130-4163). Born 150 units either way about the target on the ground, heading i * 90 degrees, ten units a frame along its heading; MoveHumming turns it at most five degrees a frame toward a point 80 units over the target, and a wobble of (rand() % 32 - 16) * 0.2 on its pitch and * 0.8 on its heading, eased by 0.6 and 0.8 a frame, keeps it from settling -- a loop about a metre round the target's middle. Its light (0.7, 0.7, 0.9) rises over the first 16 frames and falls over the last 30; its 40-point tail is JointSpirit01, added, Scale wide. The Lagul copies the joint's place and angle every frame, so it faces where it flies, and lights six of its bones (zx01-zx06, 54-59) with a blue BITMAP_SHINY + 6 at 0.3 its scale, one frame in five a smoke off a bone (ZzzEffect.cpp:8922-8948).
